product_family: Poe - a conversational AI platform providing access to multiple third-party AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, etc.) through a unified interface; supports group chats, custom bots, and creator monetization.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or Type 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 certification found in privacy policy, terms of service, or privacy center. No publicly available SOC 2 report located.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 certification found in any publicly available Poe documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy references GDPR implicitly through data subject rights language but makes no explicit GDPR compliance statement or certification claim. Policy is incorporated into broader Quora Privacy Policy.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA compliance found. Privacy policy explicitly cautions users: 'Please exercise caution and avoid sharing sensitive personal information with the bots and apps (e.g., credit card information, social security information, etc.)'

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 42001 or any AI governance certification found in public documentation.

certifications.name: CSA STAR for AI
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of CSA STAR or Cloud Security Alliance certifications found.

privacy.ai_training_note: Poe itself does NOT train on user chats. However, third-party AI model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta) may receive chat details to improve their services. Critically: third-party developers who build bots on Poe using APIs 'may view and store your chats on their servers to train their models.' Each bot displays a Privacy Shield icon (full or half-shaded) indicating whether developer training is enabled. Users should assume half-shield bots enable data training for model improvement.

security.name: Data anonymization
security.value: Poe states: 'Your interactions with bots and apps are aggregated or anonymized before they are shared with AI model providers or developers.'

security.name: User data deletion
security.value: Users can delete chats and account data from Poe systems; policy states users manage memory features.

security.name: Third-party data processor
security.value: Billing processed by third-party service provider; tax information shared with tax service provider for creator payments.

security.name: Security audit / penetration test
security.value: No public evidence of third-party security audits or penetration test reports.

products.name: Poe - Consumer Chat
products.data_scope: User chats, profile info (email, phone), device info, IP address; shared with third-party AI providers and bot developers
products.notes: Free with optional paid subscription. Access to multiple AI models via unified interface. Data shared with third-party AI providers for service improvement. Developer bots may enable model training on user data.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier + paid subscription with message limits/points)
compare.data_residency: Not specified; no public documentation on data storage location

flags: No public security certifications or trust center. Poe does not publicly disclose SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR compliance, or HIPAA status.

Critical data handling: third-party developers can access and train AI models on user chat data. While Poe officially does not train on chats, the platform enables third-party training through bot developer APIs.
Privacy Shield icons (full vs. half shield) indicate training scope, but users must manually inspect each bot. Default assumption should be that half-shield bots enable training.
Data region and encryption details not publicly disclosed.
HIPAA explicitly discouraged: privacy policy warns users not to share sensitive information (credit card, SSN), indicating non-compliance with HIPAA standards.
No AI governance certifications (ISO 42001, CSA STAR) despite operating in AI sector.
Quora Privacy Policy is incorporated by reference but not captured in this assessment; AIFOXX should review parent policy for enterprise customers.
